elaine: heads up — running into a travel hiccup, my shuttle is stuck and I won't make the 23:30 -> 03:30 overnight handoff. Can someone take primary from ~23:15 tonight until ~04:00? I'm currently primary and there's one P2 open for embeddings timeouts. Sorry for the late ask. :grimacing:

oncall-bot: Current schedule: primary=elaine, secondary=joel. Open incidents: INC-834 (P2 embeddings timeouts). Paging policy: page primary, wait 5m, then page secondary. To accept a swap, reply with "I got this" or "I can".

joel: I got this. I can take primary starting 23:15 and cover through 04:00. Quick Q — any mitigation in-flight I should be aware of for INC-834?

elaine: thanks @joel. TL;DR: after the 20:40 deploy embed-service started returning 500s on some batches. Mitigations already applied: scaled embed-service + reduced batch_size; error rate dropped from ~7% to ~2.2%. No P1s. Open items for you to watch: (1) Datadog SLO dashboard (embed latency & errors) (2) retry queue sizes in Redis (cmd below) (3) if errors spike, rollback to embed-service 1.3.2. I'll DM session keys once swap is confirmed.

```
# quick ops checks
redis-cli -h redis-prod-01 LLEN embedding:retry
kubectl -n prod get deploy embed-service -o wide
./scripts/deploy.sh rollback embed-service 1.3.2
```

elaine: runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/embedding-failures (see "post-deploy regressions" section). Handoff checklist: set Slack status to "oncall:primary", enable push notifications, confirm you can hit the Datadog dashboard, and verify you can run the `redis-cli` and `kubectl` commands.

incident-bot: Alert: embeddings.error_rate > 1.5% (was 4.8% at 20:55 UTC). No active P1s.

rachel: I can take secondary for that window. @joel — if you want me to escalate or open a formal incident doc, ping me and I'll take it.

joel: awesome, thanks @rachel. @adrian infra — if we start seeing node pressure or host OOMs while scaling, can you be the escalation contact? Need a quick thumbs up that you're reachable. :pray:

adrian: yep I'm reachable. If CPU or disk pressure spikes, first move is increase embed-service replicas: `kubectl scale deploy embed-service --replicas=6 -n prod`. I'll be watching infra metrics and will jump in if things look dicey. Also FYI I can roll a hotfix image if needed.

joel: accepted. changing my status now and will set phone to persistent notifications. I'll post a short handoff summary into #incidents when I'm fully in.

oncall-bot: Rotation update recorded. primary=joel (23:15-04:00), secondary=rachel (23:15-04:00). Paging routing adjusted to route to joel as primary. Reminder: if this swap exceeds 4 hours, please update the PagerDuty schedule.

elaine: thanks everyone — really appreciate it. I'll be offline until ~04:30. DMing the session keys now. :heart:

joel: noted. Quick operational playbook if errors >3%: 1) pause traffic via feature flag (feature:embedding-stream), 2) scale embed-service to 6 replicas, 3) notify infra (@adrian), 4) rollback to 1.3.2 if retries don't recover. I'll post exact commands into #incidents if we hit thresholds.

rachel: ack. Good luck y'all — ping me immediately if you need help or to escalate to SEs. glhf :)
